name: cifar10_10pct_plus_cifar100_humans
description: Vision classification benchmark that combines CIFAR-10 with only 10% of labels plus additional CIFAR-100 human-labeled images to simulate a low-label/transfer setting. It measures model generalization and robustness when trained with limited labeled CIFAR-10 data augmented by CIFAR-100 human annotations. Commonly used to evaluate semi-supervised and low-resource learning methods.
reputation: Moderately used in low-label/semi-supervised learning research; a niche but practical benchmark for label-efficiency studies.
